nom: medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Peel Shot

avis.titre: What I've been looking for!What I've been looking for!
avis.texte: Nice 80 ml of product for use on face. Doesn't have a strange smell to me. Purpose of this product is to ball up upon contact with your skin. The balling of the product and rubbing it into your skin is suppose to help lift off all those gunk. After rinsing, the skin is nice and smooth and noticeably brighter. Although this is a new brand for me to try, the product itself is not. I've use various Korean brands in the last decade that works exactly like this but they were hard to find and purchase. With the wide spread of availability online from Medicube, I would purchase this again.

Works well as a dry skin remover, I use it every 3-4 days and I haven't noticed any skin irritation (I have sensitive skin) I haven't noticed any skin brightening but I've only used it twice so far. Leaves skin feeling smooth and refreshed after application and removal with a warm wet cloth. It quickly removes dry skin as well because I apply it to my fingers before placing on my face and it immediately starts removing the dead skin from my fingers when I rub it onto the other hands fingers before application.

avis.titre: Light formula, great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This was a perfect addition to my nightly routine on the first try, It thankfully does what it says it does. I’ve been in the fight of my life trying to negotiate terms with my postpartum skin. Everything has either been too much or not enough so this was a pleasant surprise 🙂 my skin feels more fresh, more soft and looks noticeably lighter - LOVE IT

avis.titre: Smoother skin, but still waiting on long-term results!
avis.texte: I've been using this peel shot for about a month now, and it has definitely smoothed out my skin texture and left it feeling incredibly clean and refreshed. However, when it comes to major fading or the full "reset" benefits of the Kojic Acid and turmeric, a month isn't quite long enough to see notable results yet. It’s a great addition to a routine for a quick texture boost, but I'll need to keep using it consistently to see how it handles stubborn hyperpigmentation over time.

avis.titre: Seeing a nice differenceSeeing a nice difference
avis.texte: ve been using the Medicube Kojic Acid Peel Shot for about a month now, and I really like it. My skin feels smoother and looks brighter, and I’ve noticed my overall skin tone looks more even. It’s easy to use and hasn’t felt too harsh on my skin. I’m happy with the results so far and will definitely keep using it!

I love this. I was scared to try it because what is even that. It didn’t irritate my skin and works well in my current routine. A lot less harsh than what’s on the market. It’s a good buy and I have seen a difference in my skin. If you have hyperpigmentation or your current regimen needs a revamp, try this. You’ll like the results.

I love it ! It is definitely worth the money ! It gives a soft feel to the face after one use , it has became a huge part of my routine & I definitely recommend this as it does the work to get excess dead skin off the face . It gives the face a natural , clean shine to the face !

I’ve been loving the Medicube Peel Shot as part of my skincare routine. It helps gently exfoliate and leaves my skin feeling smoother, softer, and refreshed. I especially like how clean and glowing my skin looks afterward. It’s an easy addition to my routine when my skin needs a little extra boost!
Will definatly purchase again. Skin is a lot more smoother and brighter after use.

J'adore les produits medicube, c'est doux sur la peau, pas d'odeur et pas de réactions (je nai pas la peau sensible). Laisse le grain de peau lisse et légèrement lumineux pour le reste de la skincare. A voir dans le temps mais ya bien l'effet petit boudin qui enlève la peau morte !

I’ll review this again in a couple of weeks! I got this today and washed my wash as directed my skin has been really dull , large pores on nose and chin, lot of dead skin in t zone and chin area no matter what, I’ve also got sensitive skin & combination oily/dry. Literally 2 seconds on my face it started to clump up with dead skin , I rinsed my face skin is super soft /silky , little glowy!

I can definitely feel a difference in my skin even after the first use! What I love most about this turmeric peel serum is how smooth it makes my face feel. After applying it, my skin feels incredibly soft—like I just had a mini facial at home. It gently exfoliates without being harsh or irritating, which is a huge plus for me. You can actually feel it working, but in a really comfortable way. I’ve also noticed my skin looking brighter and more refreshed overall. It helps take away that dull look and gives a nice natural glow without making my skin feel greasy or heavy. It’s lightweight, absorbs well, and fits easily into my routine. Overall, this has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products. If you’re looking for something that smooths and brightens at the same time, I definitely recommend giving this a try!

Do love this to clean off my dead skin. I haven’t noticed much brightening or any fading dark spots though. Also- the gunk you see balling up is actually the cellulose in the serum when it mixes with your dead skin & produces a solid. So all the residue is not your “gunk”. But it definitely cleans your skin. It doesn’t immediately empty your pores like all of the videos show; but that’s a given. **disclaimer- from the very first use a month or more ago, after using it for the first time one night I woke up with a golf ball sized patch of rough and flaky skin, and have continually broken out there (never had acne in my life). So be aware if your skin is sensitive! It even stopped using it for and couple weeks and it didn’t go away. I only use this once every other week-ish.

I absolutely love it. After doing a two-step cleanse, I would have thought my face was clean, but using this product draws out even more dirt and lots of dead skin cells. My face feels incredibly soft and looks radiant, and I’ve noticed that my sun spots have lightened; I would buy this a thousand times over.
Yeah I’ve been curious about medicube and after trying this particular product I’m sold on this brand. Definitely add me to the loyal customer list lol

avis.titre: Definitely a deep clean but texture is strange
avis.texte: This is my first time using one of those “peel” serums and it’s not quite what I was expecting. I thought it would have some exfoliating beads in it or something but it doesn’t. Once applied it starts to form little clumps almost immediately. It almost feels like there is cornstarch in it and leaves the skin so dry afterward but very soft. Definitely need to moisturize afterwards. My skin definitely felt very smooth and clean though. One star off for the unpleasant texture while applying and rinsing off.

avis.titre: This really work just like u seen in the ads no shade
avis.texte: When I tell u this peel shots is the best thing even belive me

As soon as you rub this product onto your skin, it starts to clump. When I first opened the bottle, I noticed clumps already forming inside. Shaking it made it look smooth, but once I applied a few drops to my hand, it clumped up almost instantly. This occurred without any dead skin, so it doesn’t seem to be exfoliation ,just the product itself.
The package arrived perfectly but the package was opened I guess and there was no product left in it only a few pumps
